progress.output: {"body":"\"Closes #66.\\n\\npi-action never set a thinking level, so pi-durable's `resolveAgent` used `state?.thinkingLevel ?? \\\"off\\\"`: every run was **off**, also with `model_reasoning: true`. This adds `thinking_level`, with pi's default `medium`.\\n\\n## Changes\\n\\n- **Input.** `thinking_level`: `off`, `minimal`, `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh`, or `max` (pi-ai's `ModelThinkingLevel`, which includes `max`). Any case. Empty → `medium`. An invalid value fails the run with the list of valid values. `src/index.ts` now reads the inputs inside the promise chain, so the error reaches `setFailed` instead of crashing.\\n- **Every run.** `Thread.open` adds `thinkingLevel` to the agent that `configureAgent` passes to `root.configure`, so a continuing thread switches to the new level.\\n- **Capping.** pi-durable sends the level as it is (`reasoning: level`). pi-action caps it first with pi-ai's `clampThinkingLevel`, as pi does: `off` for a model without reasoning (built-in metadata, or `model_reasoning: false`); `xhigh`/`max` only when the model's `thinkingLevelMap` has them, else `high`. A capped level writes a log line, for example `thinking_level: faux/faux-1 has no reasoning support; using off`.\\n- **Provider mapping (checked in pi-ai 1.5.2).** anthropic-messages: no `reasoning` → thinking disabled; `compat.forceAdaptiveThinking` → effort (via `thinkingLevelMap`); else a thinking budget. openai-completions clamps again and sends `reasoning_effort` only with `supportsReasoningEffort`.\\n- **Setup log.** `🤖 anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5 · thinking medium · tools: …`\\n- **Docs.** README inputs table, `action.yml`, a new [Thinking](docs/models.md#thinking) section in `docs/models.md`, and the `🤖` examples in `docs/how-it-works.md` and `docs/extensions.md`.\\n\\n## Tests\\n\\n- Parsing: default, every level in any case, rejection of invalid values.\\n- Faux provider (with a reasoning model): the level reaches the request options (`options.reasoning`); `off` (no `reasoning`) and a log line for a model without reasoning; `xhigh` → `high`; no level → unchanged.\\n- A stored thread that runs with `low`, then from a new clone with `high`, sends `high`.\\n- `run.test.ts`: the setup lines with the downgrade line and `thinking off`.\\n\\n`npm run check` passes.\\n\\n## Release note (for the next release)\\n\\n```markdown\\n### Changed\\n- **Runs think at pi's default level, medium** (#66, added in #74). pi-action now sets a thinking level on every run, with the new `thinking_level` input (`off`, `minimal`, `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh`, `max`). Before, every run was `off`. Runs on models with reasoning can now use more tokens and time. To keep the old behavior, set `thinking_level: off`. Models without reasoning support get `off`, with a log line. See [Thinking](https://github.com/cv/pi-action/blob/vX.Y.Z/docs/models.md#thinking).\\n```\"\n"}
